f8b05ba7b061fc94.description: **About iCustomer** iCustomer is the Agentic Decision OS for Growth Marketing used by 100+ clients including American Eagle, Cisco, Untuckit and Crusoe to turn audience intelligence into decisions and orchestration with learning loops. We're a venture-backed, US-headquartered startup with a growing India team building the next category in growth marketing infrastructure helping growth teams optimize ROAS, CAC, and LTV. Customers don't just buy software from us, they buy outcomes. **The Role** We're hiring a hands-on QA Engineer to own quality across our platform—web applications, APIs, data pipelines, and integrations. You'll work directly with engineering and product to make sure what we ship works for customers. Our product turns data into decisions and actions. An incorrect score, missing record, or broken audience sync can affect a customer's campaign. You'll dig into those details, test complete workflows, and help us catch issues before customers do. You'll have room to shape our testing approach, build automation, and challenge requirements when something doesn't add up. We want someone who takes a feature from “looks good” to “ready to ship.” **What You'll Do** **Product Quality & Release Ownership** Own functional, exploratory, regression, and integration testing across the platform. Turn requirements into practical test scenarios, including edge cases and failure paths. Test complete customer journeys—from uploading a list to enriching, scoring, building audiences, and activating them. Run release checks, communicate risks clearly, and verify fixes before they reach customers. **API & Data Validation** Test APIs for correct responses, authentication, error handling, and unexpected inputs. Use SQL to validate data accuracy, completeness, transformations, and consistency. Catch duplicates, missing fields, incorrect mappings, and partial processing failures. Validate CRM and marketing integrations, including sync behavior, retries, and failed updates. **Test Automation** Build and maintain automated tests using Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar tools. Prioritize automation for critical workflows and recurring issues. Work with engineering to bring reliable automated checks into CI/CD. Keep tests useful as the product evolves—investigate failures and reduce flaky checks. **Customer Experience & Team Collaboration** Look beyond whether a feature works: flag confusing flows, unclear errors, and dead ends. Reproduce customer-reported issues using logs, browser tools, API responses, and data. Write bug reports that help engineers move quickly: clear steps, expected behavior, actual results, and impact. Bring findings into product discussions and help prevent repeat issues. **Who You Are** 2–4 years of QA experience testing web applications, ideally SaaS products. Strong in manual and exploratory testing—you know how to find issues a checklist misses. Hands-on with API testing using Postman or similar tools. Comfortable writing SQL to investigate and validate data. Experience building automated tests with at least one modern framework. Comfortable using browser developer tools, logs, and defect tracking tools such as Jira or Linear. Clear written and spoken English. You can explain a bug and its customer impact without a long back-and-forth. Comfortable with changing priorities and evolving requirements. Ownership mindset. You follow issues through resolution and speak up when a release carries risk. Curious and practical—you ask questions, investigate, and help the team move forward. **Bonus Points** Worked at an early-stage startup. Tested AI-powered features, data enrichment, audience platforms, or analytics products. Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or advertising platform integrations. Familiarity with BigQuery, Snowflake, or ETL pipelines. Experience with performance testing and CI/CD. Working knowledge of Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. **Logistics** Location: Remote, India-based Hours: Meaningful overlap with US Eastern Time (expect ~4–5 hours daily overlap, including customer-facing calls). Type: FTE Compensation: Competitive comp + performance bonus tied to customer outcomes + tools/ equipment] Reports to: Jose Chan, COO **How to Apply** Send us: Your resume and LinkedIn profile. A short note (200 words max) about a tricky bug you found—how you investigated it, what caused it, and why it mattered. An example of test automation you've built, or a GitHub link if available.

Renewals Operations Analyst II

Location: Bangalore

Shift: IST (2:00 P.M IST- 11:00 P.M IST)

What we’re looking for:

Role Summary

We're looking for a detail-oriented Renewal Sales Operations professional to own pipeline hygiene, renewals governance, and forecasting for our Renewals & Expansion (R+E) business. You'll be the operational backbone that keeps deals moving, risks visible, and managers accountable, translating data into clear actions for reps and sales leaders. A solid understanding of the renewal sales motion and quoting is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Hygiene & Risk Management

  • Run daily pipeline hygiene checkpoints across the R+E book of business.
  • Track deals stalled in stage for more than 15, 25, and 30 days.
  • Monitor high-value deals ($100K+) with no activity for more than 15 days.
  • Proactively surface execution risks and drive follow-up actions with reps and managers.

Renewals Governance

  • Track early engagement ownership on renewal opportunities.
  • Oversee R+E Early Renewals reporting.
  • Ensure Stage 4+ opportunities have a multi-year or co-term option quoted and marked as primary.
  • Monitor deals expiring in the next 60, 45, 30, and 15 days, and escalate at-risk renewals.

Forecasting

  • Prepare and publish the weekly forecast deck at the manager level.
  • Drive a bottom-up forecast process beginning 45 days before the next quarter.

Metrics & Manager Enablement

  • Publish weekly CQ+1 rep and manager lead metrics.
  • Give managers actionable insights that drive accountability and execution.

Policy & Account Governance

  • Manage the Exclusion List.
  • Own account transition and churn ownership transfer policies.
  • Review cases for exceptions and make or recommend decisions.

Qualifications.

  • 4-7 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales/Renewals Analytics, ideally in SaaS or subscription businesses.
  • Strong understanding of the renewal sales motion (renewal lifecycle, early engagement, forecasting, and risk/churn management) and quoting (co-terming, multi-year options, and primary quote requirements).
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce (reports, dashboards, opportunity stages, quoting/CPQ concepts).
  • Experience building forecast decks and pipeline reporting for sales leadership.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Looker) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to challenge reps and managers and drive follow-through.
  • Highly organized, deadline-driven, and comfortable running recurring daily and weekly cadences.

What Success Looks Like

  • Fewer stalled and inactive high-value deals, with risks flagged early.
  • Stage 4+ opportunities consistently carry a compliant primary quote.
  • On-time, accurate weekly forecast and lead-metric publications.
  • Clean, well-governed account transitions and exception handling.

We’re looking for a highly driven, organized, and persistent Business Development Manager to help us build and maintain relationships with representatives across the entertainment industry, including music, sports, film/TV, digital media, and more.

This is an outbound-heavy role. A large part of the job involves researching contacts, sending high-quality emails, following up consistently, tracking conversations in HubSpot, and working toward clear outreach and response goals.

This is not a passive data-entry role. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable initiating conversations, managing a large pipeline of contacts, and staying disciplined with follow-ups even when people don’t respond right away.

What You’ll Be Doing:

• Conduct high-volume outreach to entertainment industry representatives through email and social media.

• Write polished outreach emails that are clear, professional, natural, and personalized when needed.

• Follow up consistently with contacts who have not responded and keep conversations moving over time.

• Manage a large contact pipeline and make sure outreach, follow-ups, notes, and next steps are accurately tracked.

• Use HubSpot or similar CRM tools to organize contacts, tasks, follow-ups, communication history, and outreach progress.

• Work toward measurable goals around outreach volume, follow-ups, responses, verified updates, and relationship-building activity.

• Build long-term industry relationships so representatives are more likely to respond, share updates, and view us as a reliable industry resource.

• Think creatively about outreach and develop new ways to improve response rates, keep relationships warm, and strengthen our network.

Who We’re Looking For:

• Excellent written English—you’re comfortable writing professional messages and outreach emails with clarity and polish. Must have strong English writing and speaking abilities.

• Extremely organized—you can juggle many accounts and keep your outreach and follow-ups on track.

• Self-motivated and driven—you take initiative, meet goals, and stay focused without constant supervision.

• Relationship-minded—you enjoy connecting with people and maintaining positive, long-term communication.

• Familiarity with CRM tools like HubSpot is a plus.

• Spanish fluency is a plus, but not required.

• A genuine interest in the entertainment industry—especially music, sports, film/TV, or digital media—will help you succeed in this role.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bbe-marketing-inc-business-development-manager-1
